title: Air Fryer Chicken “65”

items: 450 grams chicken breasts, cut into cubes
spices ( you can add more basis your personal preference keeping in mind that marinades dilute flavours)
1 1/2 tbsp red chilli powder + 1 tbsp coriander powder + 1 tsp turmeric powder + 1 tbsp cumin powder + 1 tsp red chilli flakes + 1 tbsp garam masala + 1 tbsp chaat masala + 1 tsp
salt, to taste (if you need it)
1/2 tsp oil for basing the air fryer tray

method: Combine the chicken with all the ingredients for the marinade except the rice flour and keep in the fridge for 30 minutes minimum upto 6 hours
Before you are ready to cook, add the rice flour and mix together
Preheat airfryer to 185 degrees and let it get ready
Optional: you can base the air fryer tray with a little oil, i tried both versions and without oil didnt stick that much either
Cook for 6-10 minutes, this will depend on the size of the chicken cubes
Top with a squeeze of lime to pop. Inspired by @shadi_faleel ( her recipe but a healthier version )
tips: Swap chicken for paneer if you want a veg option (macros will be different)

Garlic + 2 green chillies sliced + 1 sprig curry leaves + 2 tbsp ketchup
Two to three minutes into cooking the chicken, i add in thinly sliced onions and a few curry leaves to brown

Air Fryer Chicken “65”
low oil | high protein 

If you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, drop a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Nutrition: 
C: 36 | F: 15 | P: 50
Calories: 423 per serve
Makes 2 large portions

Ingredients
450 grams chicken breasts, cut into cubes
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
2-3 tbsp greek yogurt
2 springs curry leaves
1/4 cup rice flour
spices ( you can add more basis your personal preference keeping in mind that marinades dilute flavours) 
1 1/2 tbsp red chilli powder + 1 tbsp coriander powder + 1 tsp turmeric powder + 1 tbsp cumin powder + 1 tsp red chilli flakes + 1 tbsp garam masala + 1 tbsp chaat masala + 1 tsp 
salt, to taste (if you need it) 
1 thinly sliced onions 
1/2 tsp oil for basing the air fryer tray
1 lemon

Dip Ingredients
1/4 cup greek yogurt
2 tbsp green chutney 
1 tsp chaat masala

Method
combine the chicken with all the ingredients for the marinade except the rice flour and keep in the fridge for 30 minutes minimum upto 6 hours 
before you are ready to cook, add the rice flour and mix together 
preheat airfryer to 185 degrees and let it get ready
optional: you can base the air fryer tray with a little oil, i tried both versions and without oil didnt stick that much either 
cook for 6-10 minutes, this will depend on the size of the chicken cubes
top with a squeeze of lime to pop.  Inspired by @shadi_faleel 😍 ( her recipe but a healthier version ) 

pro tips
swap chicken for paneer if you want a veg option (macros will be different) 

if you want to add a bit more of a flair to the final dish, add 1 tbsp oil to a pan, add in 5 cloves of sliced 

garlic + 2 green chillies sliced + 1 sprig curry leaves + 2 tbsp ketchup 
two to three minutes into cooking the chicken, i add in thinly sliced onions and a few curry leaves to brown
